title: Yet, Heard
about: Poem 09 in its scenes, on the stage's own sets: the club sidewalk, the harbour street under the moon, the phone booth on the quay, the mother's room, the quay path east at dawn, back to the booth curb. Built with rigkit.scene; keys land on the stressed word of the line. plan_v1.json is the earlier one-figure, plain-backdrop version.
